prs.title: Browser TerminalWriteCoordinator and client snapshot fence
prs.entryGate: FR-BGSTAB-017 recovery write gate contract is green and REL-BGSTAB-007 AC-4/AC-5 protocol tests pass.

prs.title: Server headless model authority shadow and driver lease
prs.entryGate: Shadow parity runs with local cache absent and poisoned (REL-BGSTAB-025 AC-2) and records no observed_loss inside retention per OBS-BGSTAB-009 AC-3.
prs.rollbackGate: Disable shadow admission; legacy stays authoritative throughout, so rollback is a flag flip with no epoch barrier.

prs.title: Single-authority promotion pilot and rollback epoch
prs.entryGate: MIG-BGSTAB-002 AC-1 parity gates pass on capability-confirmed limited sessions in a new streamEpoch.
prs.rollbackGate: MIG-BGSTAB-002 AC-5 ordered rollback: stop new admission, revoke lease, mark views stale, parser reset, discard ACK/backlog, new stream epoch, fresh compatibility checkpoint, post-snapshot output, re-enable legacy. Byte tails must not be concatenated.
prs.openDefect: Issue #69 questions MIG-BGSTAB-002 AC-4 above the 166-column checkpoint crossover measured in issue #26.

prs.title: Hidden delivery gate and authoritative snapshot recovery
prs.entryGate: Hidden and visible overflow paths converge to a fresh authoritative checkpoint rather than an empty success (REL-BGSTAB-007 AC-5).
prs.rollbackGate: Restore legacy hidden-output tail delivery; bounded by resourceLimits.terminal.hiddenOutputTailBytes, no authority change.

prs.title: Physical removal of the unsafe legacy terminal path after two release soaks
prs.entryGate: All four REL-BGSTAB-025 AC-4 deletion conditions are satisfied with recorded evidence, REL-BGSTAB-026 is stable, and two release soaks have completed.
prs.rollbackGate: NOT REVERSIBLE by revert alone once legacy code is removed. Rollback requires restoring the deleted path from a tagged commit and a fresh compatibility checkpoint. This PR is therefore gated last and separately approved.

notes: Issue #21 (reversible default flip and rollback drill) supplies the rollback-drill evidence that REL-BGSTAB-025 AC-4 condition (3) requires; it is a prerequisite of PR-E but is not itself a refresh-authority PR.
